Your recovery markers are genuinely encouraging. HRV at 115ms sits comfortably within your 100–120ms baseline, resting HR is a stellar 45bpm, and stress at 43/100 is well-managed. Your body absorbed yesterday's load better than most would. Today's planned session can go ahead — just stay honest with effort if fatigue creeps in.
